Marta — thanks for the quick reply. Confirming the Ross/Redwood signing flow: 

- We sign artifacts using RSA-4096 with SHA-256. The signature file is a detached .sig (openssl cms / gnupg-style).
- We'll include a file-level manifest inside the tarball (manifest/files.json) listing sha256 for each file and an overall bundle manifest at root.
- Public key fingerprint: SHA256:ABCD:1234:FAKE:FINGERPRINT:EXAMPLE:5678 (we'll provide the full fingerprint in the DocuSign chain-of-custody prefill).
- Signing operator: Offline HSM in our secure facility; we perform an internal two-person sign-off before releasing the .sig. The .sig is created prior to courier dispatch and will be listed in the manifest.

I've attached the signed-image.tar.gz.sig for your verification (stub). Please verify against the manifest on receipt.

Ben
